concerns.text: SC-004 requires a 95% CI for the threshold verified via bootstrapping (1000 resamples). T031 outputs CI bounds, but T032 (generating `tradeoff_curve.csv` with `ci_lower`/`ci_upper` columns) is marked as pending/rejected in the plan context. No task explicitly produces the CSV artifact required to measure SC-004's 'measurable outcome' of the regression curve's confidence bands.

SC-003 requires measuring statistical significance of differences between compression levels (pairwise tests) with multiple-comparison correction. T030 applies Bonferroni correction only to covariate coefficients (depth/complexity) and saves to `corrected_pvalues.json`. No task exists to perform pairwise hypothesis tests between compression levels and apply correction to those specific p-values as required by FR-005/SC-003.

FR-001/US1 requires generating 500 workflows with uniform depth distribution (1-20, at least 25 per level). T010 (verification) is flagged `[UNRESOLVED-CLAIM]` and T043 (fix) is pending in Phase N+1. No completed task guarantees the uniform distribution constraint is met before analysis proceeds, risking invalid data for SC-001/SC-002.

FR-004 requires recording the 'frequency of policy-violation error rate' for every run. T025 saves individual JSON logs. T032 (aggregation) is pending/rejected. Without a verified task to aggregate individual logs into a frequency/rate metric (e.g., in `tradeoff_curve.csv`), the 'error rate' metric for SC-001 cannot be derived.

FR-008/Constitution VI requires an independent Oracle Policy Engine. T050 (Constitution Check) is marked `[FAILED: unspecified]` and T060 (Runtime Check) is pending in Phase N+4. No completed task enforces the runtime isolation of the Oracle from execution logic, creating a risk of circular validation.
